review.shorterRoute: Reused proved original Gamma0 place/orbit dictionary, integral-closure chart containment and center injectivity, residue-limit identity and discriminant-power modular representation. Equal modular cross products imply equal residues of every element of the actual integral closure C[j]; hence equal centers, equal actual places and a Gamma0 orbit matrix. This avoids redoing the selected external simultaneous E4/E6 scaling, a second scaled lattice construction and the Gamma0 lattice-matrix proof. The dependency is not circular: the existing dictionary uses positive-degree orbit/fiber bijection, with no separating-form premise.
